## Blog posts

- [A Pragmatic CI/CD Pipeline with GitHub Actions](https://fabriziocafolla.github.io/harness-walle/blog/example-2): A lean GitHub Actions setup that lints, builds, tests accessibility, and deploys to GitHub Pages without turning your workflow into a maze.
- [Designing an Accessible Component Library with Astro](https://fabriziocafolla.github.io/harness-walle/blog/example): How to structure reusable, WCAG 2.2 AA components in Astro with semantic tokens, slots, and stories that stay maintainable as the system grows.
